snippet.title: Battlefield 6 Season 3 Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Season 3 begins May 12, bringing a new wave of all-out warfare to #battlefield6 and #REDSEC.

Deploy to Railway to Golmud, the largest map yet, built for massive combined-arms combat across land, air, and rail. Jump into Ranked Battle Royale in REDSEC. Squad up, climb the leaderboard, and prove your dominance. Earn 3 new weapons and 3 new attachments through the Season 3 Battle Pass to upgrade your loadout.

Pax Armata fractures as Warlords rise. The fight for control begins.

Later in Season 3, deploy to Cairo Bazaar, a lively marketplace in the heart of the city, packed with tight alleys and tactical opportunities for intense close-quarters combat. Become a merchant of destruction.

See what’s coming next in the 2026 Battlefield Roadmap: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f30YjQg4rn0
